data.title: 迷迭香 · 浅水湾双手接住漂浮肥皂泡的专注眼神
data.action: 赤足蹲在没过脚掌的温热浅海滩上，双手小心翼翼地向上托举，试图接住随海风飘来的彩色透明肥皂泡
data.location: 风平浪静、水清沙幼的儿童海滨游乐浅水区
data.lighting: 上午十一点纯澈透亮的阳光打在五彩斑斓的肥皂泡与浅滩水波上，折射出无数七彩光晕与晶莹高光
data.mood: 纯真无暇、专注好奇与令人心生怜惜的平静快乐
data.description: 海风带过远处孩童吹出的成串泡泡。迷迭香一身素洁白净的纯棉泳裙，小小的猫耳随着泡泡的轨迹一动一动，猫尾在身后水面上轻轻拍出小小的水花。她小心翼翼地屏住呼吸，伸出两只小手去托一枚快要落下的彩虹泡泡，转过头用清澈见底的蓝眼睛望向你——「博士……看，泡泡里装着大海的颜色。我……用神经念力把它托住了，它没有碎哦。你能帮我把它记在终端里吗？」
data.promptProse: Rosmontis crouches barefoot in clear, calm shallow sea water on a bright early-summer morning, wearing a snow-white ruffled swimdress piped in baby blue with small silver bell ties and a translucent sun cape. Gently cupping both small hands to cradle a drifting rainbow soap bubble, she looks toward the viewer with wide, clear green eyes.
data.animaCaption: Crouching barefoot in warm ankle-deep shallows in a white baby-blue-trimmed ruffled swimdress and sheer sun cape, she carefully cups both hands beneath a floating iridescent soap bubble and looks over with quiet wonder. Clear late-morning sunlight sparkles across the ripples and rainbow bubble sheen.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a snow-white cotton-feel ruffled swimdress piped in baby blue with small silver bell ties and a drifting sheer sun cape.
